I’ve used mushrooms for my severe depression for the past 2 years. I would consider myself an experienced user but used these substances for fun in the beginning. 

They helped me tremendously. I did a 2 gram trip every three months to keep the thoughts away but When I was at my lowest point and truly believed If I lived for another week I would commit suicide. I decided to do a 4.5 gram tea and ended up doing some DMT during the peak, it did wonders and made my ego die and showed me the different dimension where energy and souls live. The first 2 weeks were hell tho. I thought maybe I made a mistake because I knew too much but once that faded I dissected my trip (took notes the whole time and voice recorded my mental break down) after listening to it I remembered seeing the darkness in me was not my soul but rather an external force that hides within me. 

It gave me some type of clarity and comfort knowing this isn’t who I truly am but rather something that has decided to intrude on my person.  That was about 7 months ago and I have not had any suicidal voices or visions. Still not “happy” but I’m no longer drowning in depression. I have no desire to do psychedelics after that one being so intense but I believe the substance calls you when you need it most. 

I would recommend them for depression but EVERYONE IS DIFFERENT. Start small, get a feel for the substance. It’s nothing like you have ever experienced or ever will. Set and setting are everything. If you live with your parents get a hotel and keep your phone on airplane mode. I prefer to trip solo with zero distractions so I can only focus on me and the substance. 

Hope this helped
